description: Real figures pulled verbatim from Live Nation Entertainment's audited SEC Form 10-K filings (FY2025 and FY2024) and the corresponding FY2025 investor press release — ticket volumes, fee-bearing GTV, client counts, and category growth mix. This is free, publicly available investor-reporting data (SEC EDGAR), not a paid vendor feed.
spec_note: REAL-EXTRACT, source pack workflow/verify/us-stats.md section 2. All values quoted or paraphrased directly from primary SEC filings / press release; the FY2024 fee-bearing-ticket figure has a known unexplained restatement between the FY2024 10-K (331m) and the FY2025 10-K's MD&A comparator (340m) — both are preserved verbatim, not blended.

records.metric: Total tickets distributed through Ticketmaster systems
records.detail: Item 1 (Business): 'distributing 646 million tickets through our systems in 2025.'
MD&A: 'We sold 346 million fee-bearing tickets in 2025 compared to 340 million tickets last year, up 6 million tickets or 2%.'
MD&A: 'Fee-bearing GTV for the year was $37.1 billion, up $2.1 billion, or 6% compared to 2024.'

records.metric: Non-fee-bearing tickets sold (season packages, venue box offices, other channels)
records.detail: Item 1: 'approximately 300 million tickets were sold, for which we did not receive a fee, using our Ticketmaster systems...'
Press release: 'Ticketing fee-bearing gross transaction value (GTV) for concerts grew 9% to $26 billion.'
Press release: 'Fee-bearing tickets increased 2% to 346 million, driven by concerts up 4% offsetting a 2% decline in sports.'

records.metric: Total tickets distributed through Ticketmaster systems
records.detail: FY2024 10-K, Item 1: 'distributing over 637 million tickets through our systems in 2024.'

records.metric: Fee-bearing tickets sold (as originally reported in FY2024 10-K)
records.detail: FY2024 10-K: 'we sold approximately 331 million tickets in 2024 on which we were paid fees for our services.' NOTE: the later FY2025 10-K MD&A restates 2024 fee-bearing tickets as 340 million (see us-stats.md caveat) — an unexplained restatement between filings; both figures are carried here, do not blend them.
FY2024 10-K: 'approximately 307 million tickets were sold, for which we did not receive a fee...'
